inference.unit: accepted RTH session with no-trade zero

non_reproducible_leads.reason: Feature-labeling tutorial, not a complete entry/exit strategy.
Requires individual calendar-spread legs and OU calibration inputs not present in the NQ/MNQ continuous cache.
Requires a point-in-time ETF constituent universe and cross-sectional portfolio data.
Walk-forward methodology post does not provide a complete strategy rule.
Oscillator names, thresholds, filters, stop, and reversal-exit definitions are absent.

limitations: Retrospective historical evaluation only; all 2018-2025 years were previously inspected.
One-minute OHLCV cannot resolve within-minute stop/target order; adverse-first is used.
Daily equity/index rules are adapted to NQ/MNQ RTH and next-open executable fills.
No-stop source strategies have unbounded modeled gap risk and automatically fail the protective-stop promotion gate.
NQ and MNQ are the same underlying signal and are not independent replications.
